images.caption:
Accession:68-561-C
Block, Tackle, CSS Neuse
8"H x 6" W
Tackle block recovered from the CSS Neuse. The Neuse was a Confederate Navy Ironclad built for duty on the inland waterways of North Carolina. She was burnt to avoid capture by Union forces during Sherman's march.

Collection fo Curator Branch, Naval History and Heritage Command
